traits.bark_colour.note: The bark colour chosen by eye for appearance (see its note), as a screen colour: it stood as appearance.bark [0.4, 0.32, 0.24], which is linear light, so the trunk drew pale grey to white beside photographs of the species (2026-10-23). It stands here in sRGB, as bark colours are picked, and the bark rule (tracheophyta) turns it into linear light.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a shrub (FEIS, Anderson 2001).

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "It generally grows 2 to 9 feet tall (0.5-2.7 m) ... though it may also reach heights of 12 to 13 feet (4 m)".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "The leaves are alternate, 1 to 3 inches long" (2.5-7.6 cm).

traits.leaf_width_m.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): leaves "0.5 to 2 inches (1.5-5 cm) wide".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "evergreen shrub".

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "The leaves are alternate".

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): the inflorescence is "branched with many flowers", on axillary and terminal peduncles: a panicle.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high) of 4-12 cm, its top FEIS's "less than 5 inches (12 cm) long" (Anderson 2001).

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "Fruit is shallowly 3-lobed", each lobe with a single seed: a capsule.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): fruit "0.12 to 0.16 inch (3-4 mm) thick ... 0.27 inch (6 mm) across".

traits.juvenile_period_years.note: FEIS's snowbrush ceanothus review (Anderson 2001, read 2026-10-15): "It 1st produces seed at about 3 to 6 years of age".

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review's months were not read.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review's months were not read.

generator.params.note: Red-flowering currant's values, changed by hand for snowbrush: several stems from the base branching freely into a dense, round-topped bush (FEIS, Anderson 2001), small evergreen leaves kept into a second year, and branched clusters of white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.6 m at 12 years in the open, within FEIS's usual 0.5-2.7 m (Anderson 2001). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: glossy dark green, finely toothed ovate leaves; dense plumes of tiny white flowers; brown 3-lobed capsules.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706917), as no source read gives it.

traits.life_span.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706917), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706917), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706917), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706917), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_apex.note: FNA, Ceanothus velutinus (read 2026-10-18): the leaf tip is obtuse.
